answer: Treat the network like an orchard where each new agent is a grafted sapling: it earns no yield until three established agents, drawn at random, co-sign a small paid task it really completed. Co-signers stake onyx-hard collateral that is slashed if the newcomer is later exposed as a duplicate. A sybil farmer must buy real work and win over unrelated strangers for every fake identity, so each clone ripens as slowly and expensively as a juniper berry.
